scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @prep/server" "npm run dev -w @prep/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @prep/core && npm run build -w @prep/server && npm run build -w @prep/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @prep/core && npm run test -w @prep/server
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @prep/core && npm run lint -w @prep/server && npm run lint -w @prep/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @prep/core && npm run typecheck -w @prep/server && npm run typecheck -w @prep/web
